key_insight: Adding one scalar coordinate lifts a convex domain into a cone, unifying several optimization algorithms without a user-tuned learning rate.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a principled route to reducing learning-rate tuning in online and stochastic convex optimization, including on unbounded domains.
method: Lift decisions into a cone and construct subgradients orthogonal to the lifted decisions.
Apply Follow-the-Regularized-Leader or Online Mirror Descent, leaving comparator scale free to optimize in the regret analysis.
Recover CBA and CBA+ on bounded domains and exactly recover KT coin betting on unconstrained Hilbert spaces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical regret guarantees and exact algorithmic recoveries, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Guarantees depend on domain geometry and gradient assumptions; the general closed-convex-domain result requires a known gradient bound, while a separate unconstrained algorithm removes that requirement.
